result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. Found 2 minor issues: a horizontally clipped restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and a partially cut-off category filter chip on the right edge. Both are typical carousel overflow patterns but could be improved with visual affordances.

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is clipped at the right edge of the screen, with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or fade-out affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient fade or peek of the next card plus a scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable; ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation at a consistent width.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy') shows a partially visible chip cut off at the right edge with no visual cue that more categories are available via horizontal scroll.
issues.suggestion: Provide a scroll affordance (edge fade, chevron, or partial chip peek with consistent spacing) so users discover additional filter categories.
